Ordered a dress from the website. Site states the boutique is in CA and that the item would ship from CA. The item shipped from China. I waited. Never gave a delivery time or anything. When the dress arrived it was not the dress we ordered. Not the same material, color, style, brand or anything. Their website states I could do a full refund. The company is offering 20% back then 50% and then said I could ship it back to China at my own expense. I said no because it’s not my fault the company in CA had someone from China choose the wrong product. The owner has now stepped in and offered 70% back and that I could keep the dress. I don’t want the dress. It’s not an appropriate dress for my daughter and I feel I should receive a full refund and they can have the dress back. If the shop was really located in CA the issue of them not being able to ship to China wouldn’t be an issue like they are saying.
PayPal is covering for this furdulent company.
